description: This PHP source file contains a test class 'PimCsvDataImportServiceTest' that extends 'KernelTestCase' and includes multiple unit tests for the 'PimCsvDataImportService' class. The tests validate importing CSV data related to employee records, including handling duplicates, invalid data, and various edge cases, as well as interactions with external services like 'EmployeeService' and 'CountryService'.

classes.name: PimCsvDataImportServiceTest
classes.description: This class contains multiple test methods to validate the functionality of importing CSV data for the 'PimCsvDataImportService', covering various scenarios like successful import, duplicates, invalid data, and edge cases.

methods.name: setUpBeforeClass
methods.description: Initial setup that populates country and nationality data from fixture files before any tests are run.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Prepares the test environment by truncating specific tables and instantiating the service under test.

methods.name: testGetCsvDataImportService
methods.description: Verifies that the service properly returns an instance of CsvDataImportService.

methods.name: testImport
methods.description: Tests importing a sample CSV content and checks for successful import results.

methods.name: testImportWithDuplicateEmployeeId
methods.description: Validates handling of duplicate employee IDs during import, ensuring duplicates are detected and counted as failed.

methods.name: testImportWithInvalidFirstNameAndLastName
methods.description: Checks behavior when CSV contains invalid or missing first and last names, expecting some rows to fail.

methods.name: testImportWithInvalidLicenseExpiryDate
methods.description: Tests the import process with invalid license expiry dates; currently expects all rows to succeed, but comments indicate expected failure for invalid dates.

methods.name: testImportWithInvalidMaritalStatus
methods.description: Verifies the handling of invalid marital status entries, expecting proper validation handling.

methods.name: testImportWithNationality
methods.description: Checks import with nationality data, including valid and invalid nationality entries.

methods.name: testImportWithContactDetails
methods.description: Validates importing contact detail information, including multiple phone and email fields.

methods.name: testImportWithDuplicateMailForSameEmployee
methods.description: Tests handling of duplicate email addresses for the same employee, ensuring duplicates are tracked.

methods.name: testImportWithDuplicateMail
methods.description: Checks import where multiple employees share the same email addresses, validating duplicate detection.

methods.name: testImportWithoutFirstNameAndLastName
methods.description: Tests import rows with missing first and last names, verifying validation and error counting.
